# Hi, I’m Dia Kaewdee.

I am a Business Administration student at Cal Poly Pomona with a focus on marketing, and an interest in consumer behavior, retail marketing, fashion, brand strategy, and digital analytics. My work combines creative thinking with data-driven decision making, especially in areas where customer experience and marketing strategy connect.

My portfolio highlights projects using Quarto, GitHub, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, BigQuery, Excel, Tableau, and R. It also reflects my customer-facing retail experience, which has helped me understand how people make purchasing decisions in real business settings.

## Professional Focus

I am interested in marketing roles that combine creativity, customer insight, and measurable strategy. My career interests include fashion and retail marketing, digital marketing, brand strategy, consumer behavior, and marketing analytics.
